Collaborative team

title: Director, Clinical Researcher
description:
About Hello Heart :

Hello Heart is on a mission to make heart attacks a thing of the past.

We’re an AI company focused exclusively on heart health, building a platform that predicts and prevents cardiac events before they happen-identifying risk up to 10 days in advance versus 10 years in traditional clinical models.

This is already working at scale. Hello Heart has been shown to reduce inpatient hospital days by 47% and deliver ~$1,800 in annual savings per member. Hello Heart is the cardiac prevention partner to over 80% of large U.S. health plans and serves hundreds of public and private employers.

We’re defining how the #1 cause of death-heart disease-is managed in the AI era. Join us.

About the Role
Hello Heart is seeking a Director, Clinical Research to lead the clinical and economic evidence strategy to showcase how Hello Heart products help members understand and improve their heart health through AI, hardware, and behavioral science.
Reporting into our VP, Commercial Actuary, you will set our research and publications strategy; partnering with Commercial & Product Leadership, Medical Affairs, Data Science, Product, Sales, and Marketing to drive peer reviewed publications, white papers, conference abstracts, and client facing evidence that support our commercial goals. You will apply your expertise in statistics, claims analysis, and clinical research to shape our study pipeline, build partnerships with leading research institutes and consultants, and represent Hello Heart ’s evidence to technical and executive audiences.
This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys rigorous research, clear communication, cross-functional collaboration, and turning complex data into evidence that supports better heart health outcomes.
What you’ll do

• Collaborate with leadership and cross-functional partners to prioritize clinical and economic research priorities.

• Provide peer review and mentorship to other researchers on the team, developing their analytical and publication skills over time.

• Generate research questions and develop analytical plans for key publication and evidence-generation priorities.

• Develop partnerships and work alongside leading research institutes.

• Build Hello Heart 's research and evidence strategy to support future FDA-regulated capabilities, accounting for regulatory requirements and timelines.

• Identify, organize, query, and analyze diverse datasets, including clinical, claims, electronic health record (EHR), and engagement data.

• Apply advanced statistical methods, including multilevel modeling, causal inference methods, propensity score matching, mixed-effects modeling, longitudinal analyses, and sensitivity testing.

• Collaborate with co-authors to incorporate feedback and finalize analyses, manuscripts, white papers, and abstracts.

• Respond to anonymous peer reviews, including repeat analyses and manuscript revisions, to support timely resubmission.

• Identify relevant conferences for abstract submission and present ongoing research when appropriate.

• Stay current on scientific research related to cardiovascular health, digital health, behavioral science, chronic disease, health economics, and public health.

• Contribute to data summaries, research protocols, institutional review board (IRB) materials, and other research documentation.

• Translate complex analytical findings into clear, accurate, and actionable insights for clinical, technical, commercial, and executive audiences.

What you’ll bring

• Graduate degree in a clinical field, epidemiology, biostatistics, public health, or a related field, such as Master of Science (MS), Master of Public Health (MPH), Doctor of Philosophy (PhD), or Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD), with 10+ years of clinical research experience.

• Demonstrated experience working in a commercial research setting, comfortable balancing scientific rigor with business needs.

• Experience leading or mentoring a team of researchers, including peer-reviewing

TITLE: Director of Workforce Transformation

At Career Team, our mission is to empower one person, start one career, and serve one family at a time. We do this through innovative software solutions and high-touch services.
We’re the only workforce technology company that also runs workforce boards as a managed services operator. When a state partners with us, they get more than software; they get the operating playbook we’ve built running boards across the country.
As the Director of Workforce Transformation , you’ll be the human face of this competitive advantage and bring that playbook to life for our state customers. You won’t just configure software to match the way things have always been done. Instead, you’ll sit with state leaders and local workforce boards, look honestly at how they serve job seekers and employers today, and help them redesign the model: people, process, and platform together.

• You’ll use your workforce experience and expertise to see the big picture while also understanding the nuances and tiny details of the business. You’ll turn high-level workforce directives (referral processes, case management, programmatic financial tracking, labor exchange requirements, etc.) into clear technical process flows inside Career Edge.

• We don't do "tech for tech’s sake." You’ll guide workforce boards to move past just using a new tool and help them master it to change lives. You’re workforce expertise is the secret ingredient that turns a digital platform into a community superpower.

Who You Are

• A dynamic career journey combining a strong academic foundation (Bachelor's or higher) with over 5 years of experience in workforce development.

• Your background spans workforce services at multiple levels-ideally across boards, regions, or states-giving you a ground-up understanding of service delivery.

• You have experience collaborating with state and local workforce boards, managing regional differences, and navigating complex, locally-specific requirements.

title: AI research scientist
description:
🚀 ABOUT WRITER

WRITER is where the world's leading enterprises orchestrate AI-powered work. Our vision is to expand human capacity through superintelligence. And we're proving it's possible - through powerful, trustworthy AI that unites IT and business teams together to unlock enterprise-wide transformation. With WRITER's end-to-end platform, hundreds of companies like Mars, Marriott, Uber, and Vanguard are building and deploying AI agents that are grounded in their company's data and fueled by WRITER's enterprise-grade LLMs. Valued at $1.9B and backed by industry-leading investors including Premji Invest, Radical Ventures, and ICONIQ Growth, WRITER is rapidly cementing its position as the leader in enterprise generative AI.

Founded in 2020 with office hubs in San Francisco, New York City, Austin, Chicago, and London, our team thinks big and moves fast, and we're looking for smart, hardworking builders and scalers to join us on our journey to create a better future of work with AI.

 
 

📐 ABOUT THE ROLE

AI research at WRITER isn't just about publishing papers - it's about building the scientific foundation that powers some of the most ambitious enterprise AI deployments in the world. As an AI research scientist, you'll be at the center of that work. You'll drive a high-impact research agenda focused on large language models, agentic reasoning, and the system-level capabilities that make AI genuinely useful at enterprise scale. This is a rare opportunity to do research that matters twice over - advancing the field and shipping directly into products used by hundreds of thousands of people every day.

We're at an inflection point. Enterprises are moving from experimenting with AI to deeply embedding it across their operations, and WRITER's models are the engine making that possible. The work you do here - on post-training, planning, multi-step reasoning, and agentic workflows - will directly shape how the next generation of enterprise AI behaves, performs, and scales. You'll have the resources, infrastructure, and cross-functional support to pursue ambitious ideas and bring them to life quickly. This role is hybrid, based out of our San Francisco or New York City hub.

You'll report to our VP of AI research. Please note: role is open to Senior, Staff, and Sr. Staff applicants

We are open to hiring for this role at multiple levels, with compensation ranges scaled to match your experience, expertise, and the scope of the role.

 
 

🦸🏻‍♀️ WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead an independent, high-impact research agenda on large language models and agentic systems, owning projects from early hypothesis through model training, evaluation, and production deployment

- Design and execute large-scale post-training experiments using supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), RLAIF, DPO, and emerging alignment techniques - with a focus on improving multi-step reasoning, planning, and tool use in enterprise agentic workflows

- Build novel evaluation benchmarks and methodologies that push beyond existing limitations, establishing rigorous measures for how well models perform on complex, real-world enterprise tasks

- Develop scalable data synthesis and curation pipelines that generate the high-quality training signal driving model improvement - including LLM-as-judge frameworks, synthetic data generation, and adversarial dataset construction

- Shape WRITER's model architecture and training roadmap by translating your research insights into concrete improvements to our enterprise-grade LLMs, working hand-in-hand with research engineering and product teams

- Publish and present original research at top-tier venues - NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, and others - representing WRITER at the frontier of the field and contributing to the broader scientific community

- Mentor and uplevel fellow researchers and engineers on the team, helping set a high bar for scientific rigor, experimental design, and research culture

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar - it means a lot that our work resonates with others. At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem - helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 

ABOUT THE JOB

 
We are looking for an  Staff PCB Designer / Staff Layout Engineer  to join our rapidly growing team in  Costa Mesa, CA . In this role, you will work closely with avionics, system, and software engineers to create test systems for development, qualification, verification, and validation purposes. If you are someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment supporting new developments, active deployments, and customer operated hardware, we are looking for you.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 10+ years of experience with PCB layout

• 5+ years of experience with Altium

• Ability to read and interpret schematics, apply best practices appropriate for each design, and push back on schematic or architectural decisions that create layout, manufacturability, or integrity risk

• Deep understanding of PCB fabrication and assembly processes, limitations, design rules, and best practices, including the ability to define and validate stackups with fabricators

• Experience owning ECAD libraries and library standards - footprint creation and verification, IPC compliance, and governance across multiple designers

• Expert-level high speed digital layout and controlled impedance routing - DDR, PCIe, SerDes, Ethernet, USB - including length/skew matching, differential pair routing, and return path management

• Experience with high density designs: fine-pitch BGA fanout, HDI/microvia construction, and stackups greater than 12 layers

• Demonstrated technical leadership: serving as lead designer on complex or multi-board programs, setting and documenting layout constraints, conducting design reviews, and mentoring less experienced designers

• Ability to manage layout scope, schedule, and risk across concurrent programs while collaborating with electrical, mechanical, and program teams

• Eligible for security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• CID+, CID++ and/or PCEA-CPCD certification

• Working experience applying MIL-STD and IPC standards, including IPC-2221/2222, IPC-6012 Class 3, and IPC-A-610

• Experience with rigid-flex, RF/mixed-signal, and thermally constrained designs

• Experience designing and analyzing power distribution networks using SI/PI tools (HyperLynx, Ansys SIwave, Cadence Sigrity, or equivalent)

• Advanced Altium proficiency: constraint/rule management, scripting or automation, Altium 365/Concord Pro, and version-controlled design data

• Experience leading DFM/DFA engagement with fab and assembly vendors through NPI

• Experience introducing or improving ECAD process, design standards, or documentation practices for a team

• Thriving in a fast-paced environment

• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or similar

title: Chief of Staff to the CEO
description:
The job in one line
You run the CEO's operating system: goals, cadence, and follow-through. You also personally own the projects that don't have a home yet.
Everyday Dose is moving fast in a lot of directions at once. The constraint isn't ideas or effort. It's making sure the right handful of things get set, tracked, and actually finished while everything else keeps running.
That's this job. It is not an executive assistant role and it is not a note-taking role. You'll own outcomes, run the meeting the leadership team is accountable to, and have a real seat.
What you'll actually do
Own goal setting. Run quarterly and annual planning end to end. Sit with each exec, turn intent into targets that are measurable and few. Hold the line when a goal is a paragraph instead of a number. Publish it so the whole company knows what we're playing for.
Manage against those goals. Goals decay the week after they're written unless someone owns them. You're that someone. You track progress, surface slippage early, and escalate the things that need the CEO before they become fires.
Run the weekly leadership meeting. Set the agenda, bring the numbers, drive to decisions. Every meeting ends with owners and dates, and you chase them down between meetings. You're not the scribe; you're the person who makes the hour worth everyone's time.
Keep the scoreboard honest. Build and maintain the company-level reporting leadership runs on, in partnership with finance and data. Numbers come from the warehouse, not from someone's recollection on a call. If two sources disagree, you're the one who reconciles them.
Run special projects. The high-stakes, cross-functional thing that has no owner: a new bet, a partnership, a channel or business we're deciding whether to enter, a problem that spans three teams and belongs to none of them. You get handed ambiguity and come back with an answer, a model, and a plan.
Be the CEO's second read. Pressure-test decisions before they're made. Prep board and investor materials. Write the memo when the thinking needs to be sharp. Say the thing nobody else in the room will say.
What success looks like in 90 days

• Company goals for the quarter are written, owned, and measurable, and every leader can recite theirs without opening a doc

• The weekly leadership meeting has a repeatable format, a live scoreboard, and decisions that stick

• One company-level dashboard everyone trusts, sourced from the warehouse

• Two special projects taken from ambiguous to finished without supervision

• The CEO's time visibly reallocated toward the highest-leverage work in the business

Requirements
What we're looking for

•
8 to 12 years of experience , including time as a Chief of Staff, BizOps lead, Strategy & Operations lead, or equivalent to a founder/CEO or a senior exec

•
Top pedigree. Strong academic background and time at companies with a known high bar, plus a record of being promoted inside them. We look hard at both.

•
Left brain. You're fluent in a spreadsheet and comfortable in a data environment. You can build a model, size an opportunity, read a cohort curve, and pull your own numbers rather than filing a ticket and waiting.

•
Right brain. You write exceptionally well. Memos, board decks, exec comms. You can take a messy 90-minute discussion and turn it into one page that changes what people do.

•
You've run an operating cadence (OKRs or equivalent, weekly business reviews, planning cycles) at a company doing real volume, not as a theory from a deck.

•
Backbone. You will regularly tell senior, accomplished people that their goal isn't measurable or their project is late. You do it without drama and without flinching, and they respect you for it.

•
Startup metabolism. High ambiguity, fast context switching, nothing beneath you. You'd rather own the outcome than protect the org chart.

•

• Track and trend laboratory efficiency and quality

Promote the company to local, regional, national, and international constituencies through networking, speaking engagements, activity in professional associations and publications

• Must have a Ph.D. in life sciences or relevant field (preferably Immunology, Cellular Biology)

• Strong bench scientist skills around cell-based assays. Hands on flow cytometry experience is required. Preferably with experience in ELISpot and other cell based assays. C

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

DEINE ROLLE:

- Team aufbauen und entwickeln: Du startest entweder als erstes Teammitglied oder mit einem kleinen Team, das du weiter ausbaust.

- Du entwickelst dein Team durch Coaching, Shadowing und Roleplays - nicht nur durch Steuerung & Monitoring.

- Lead by Example: In der Aufbauphase gewinnst du auch selbst Neukund:innen, mit einem klar definierten eigenen Zielanteil. So kennst du den Markt aus erster Hand.

- Präsenz im Markt: Du begleitest dein Team zu Terminen, unterstützt in der Akquise und überzeugst live in Demos.

- Du steuerst datenbasiert - über KPIs und Pipeline. Du kennst die Zahlen deiner Teammitglieder und leitest daraus frühzeitig Maßnahmen ab.

- Struktur und Rhythmus: Du organisierst die Woche, führst 1:1-Gespräche, löst Hindernisse schnell und sorgst für saubere Arbeit im CRM.

- Du entwickelst deine Region strategisch weiter und wirkst an der Optimierung unserer Vertriebsprozesse mit.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb, davon nachweisbar im Außendienst (Field Sales) mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung.

- Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Neukundengewinnung: Du kannst mit Zahlen belegen, was du erreicht hast und woran du festmachst, dass du darin gut bist.

- Führungserfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Wichtiger ist, dass du die Fähigkeiten hast, deine Teammitglieder zu entwickeln und für Wachstum zu sorgen. Relevante Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Mentoring, Onboarding neuer Kolleg:innen oder in Projekten sind hilfreich.

- Datenaffinität: Du arbeitest sicher mit KPIs, Pipeline und Forecast und leitest daraus Entscheidungen ab.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du planst deine Region eigenständig und setzt klare Prioritäten.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Führungskräfte-Entwicklung von Tag 1: Unsere Sales Manager Academy begleitet dich beim Einstieg in die Führungsrolle - gerade dann, wenn es dein erstes Team ist.

- Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entscheidest mit, wen du einstellst und wie dein Team arbeitet.

- Ein Vergütungspaket, das Team- und Eigenleistung honoriert: attraktives Fixum plus ungedeckelte Provision.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

We’re always innovating and driving our SHARP values to offer new solutions that satisfy our consumers, drive ROI for our clients and create an empowering workplace for our employees.
Equity, Diversity & Inclusion at Pion

At Pion , inclusivity, diversity, and respect are at our core. We value accountability and are fully transparent about our ED&I efforts-our commitments and internal stats are open for all to see. Our culture is shaped by our people, and it’s all part of life at Pion .
Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet 60% of the requirements, women and those in underrepresented groups tend to only apply when they tick every box. We don’t think you should have to tick every box. We value your uniqueness, and it goes without saying that all applications are welcome, even if you don’t think you fit the criteria.
If you need any adjustments to support you with your application, just drop us an email at .
As a result of our incredible success and growth, we are looking for a Credit Controller to join us.
Responsibilities include

• Own a personal ledger within the team's shared cash collection target, proactively chasing invoices rather than just following process from very old, overdue accounts to invoices due for the first time.

• Contact customers and their payment partners to confirm invoices have been received and scheduled for payment, chasing consistently in the run-up to and past the due date.

• Strong relationship-building skills across different stakeholders, from finance and sales through to customers and third parties.

• A logical, detail-focused mindset with the ability to prioritise and manage your own workload efficiently.

title: Vice President, AI Data
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

ABOUT US

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology. Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward. Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us-we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

The role

At Wayve, we are building AI that learns to drive from experience.

We do not hand-code cars to drive. We train our models from data gathered across the real world, making our ability to identify, understand and learn from the right data fundamental to everything we build.

We are looking for a VP of Data to lead the data strategy behind our autonomous driving technology.

This is a senior engineering leadership role with end-to-end ownership of how Wayve uses data to improve our AI. You will determine what data we need, how we acquire it, how we understand and enrich it, and ultimately how we turn it into measurable improvements in model performance.

The scale and shape of the problem is unique. Our data comes from our own vehicles, OEM programmes, partners and external sources, spanning different vehicles, sensors, markets and driving environments. Within that corpus, the most valuable examples are often the hardest to find: rare behaviours, unusual interactions, safety-critical events and the long tail of real-world driving.

Your job is not simply to build the systems that process this data. It is to decide what data matters and why, and build the strategy, organisation and learning loop that allows Wayve to learn from it faster.

You will lead Wayve’s Data organisation and provide senior ownership for data within Engineering, partnering closely across AI, Science, Validation, Product, Compute and our commercial teams.

Key Responsibilities

- Own Wayve’s data strategy: Set the strategy across the complete AI learning cycle, determining what data we need and how it should drive model performance, from foundation model training through specialised driving capabilities and production programmes.

- Build the data flywheel: Own the learning loop from real-world signals and model behaviour through data discovery, curation and enrichment into training, evaluation, deployment and measurement.

- Find the data that matters: Develop intelligent approaches to discovering rare, surprising and safety-critical scenarios within extremely large datasets, using techniques such as embeddings, semantic search, learned representations and model-driven data selection.

- Lead data acquisition and enrichment: Define how Wayve collects, buys, generates and enriches data across our own fleet, OEM programmes, partners and external sources, balancing coverage, quality, speed and economics.

- Connect data investment to model performance: Establish how we measure the value of data and make rigorous trade-offs across quality, accuracy, speed, cost and scale, ensuring investment is focused where it creates the greatest impact.

- Scale our data strategy globally: Build an approach that supports multiple OEMs, vehicle platforms, sensor configurations, geographies and regulatory environments while maintaining a scalable global architecture.

AnswerAide is actively seeking an enthusiastic full-time, part-time, and on-call Answering Service Agent to provide quality customer service. Are you a people person who enjoys talking on the phone ? Can you provide quality customer service? Do you want to work for a supportive and growing company ? If so, please continue reading!

This phone operator position earns a competitive wage based on your skills. We provide great benefits and perks , including medical, dental, vision, short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, and paid time off (PTO) . If this sounds like the right customer service opportunity as a phone operator for you, apply today !

ABOUT ANSWER AIDE

AnswerAide is a dedicated provider of 24/7 telephone answering services and customer service outsourcing for businesses. Our superb team handles the after-hours and overflow phone calls, customer service outsourcing, and other administrative tasks when needed for our clients. Our services help various companies stay at the top of their industries because of the excellent support their customers receive. We strive to create the best experience for every caller by treating them like our own customers, and we treat our own customers like they are family.

Our team always goes the extra mile to ensure that all calls are handled professionally. Customer service training is provided to all employees so that everyone can give the highest quality of service. Our business wouldn't thrive without our employees, and we like to show them our appreciation by offering a positive work environment and exceptional benefits !

A DAY IN THE LIFE OF AN ANSWERING SERVICE AGENT

As a virtual receptionist, you are the backbone of our company. Your main responsibilities include receiving inbound calls and placing outbound calls. You listen attentively and collect customer data to provide them with basic information about the services and support they seek. Taking accurate notes and detailed messages is a main part of the job, and you have no problem balancing this while speaking clearly on the phone. You help schedule appointments for customers and process orders and payments while ensuring all calls are documented and reported to the appropriate business. Maintaining order is a skill that comes naturally to you, and you find great satisfaction in helping others through quality customer service!

QUALIFICATIONS OF AN ANSWERING SERVICE AGENT

• A resident of AL, FL, GA, or TX

• Ability to type 40+ words per minute with minimal errors

• Ability to follow instructions

• Must be able to multitask (talk, type, and follow scripting verbatim)

• Strong customer service skills

• Strong computer skills

• Being bilingual is not required, but a plus

COMPUTER REQUIREMENTS
-PC w/ Windows 11

-Memory (RAM): 8GB minimum

-Hard Drive: 100 GB minimum available space
-PC should be less than three years old
-High-speed internet with a minimum of 50 Mbps download speed, with low latency. No wireless, cellular, satellite, or Wi-Fi connections
-Please view our full list of equipment requirements

Do you have excellent verbal and written communication skills? Can you maintain professionalism and use a clear speaking voice on the phone? Can you balance multiple tasks at once while demonstrating good time management? Do you have an upbeat, enthusiastic, and friendly personality? Are you detail-oriented? If so, we want to hear from you about this phone operator opportunity!

Performs ambulatory chart review to determine appropriate code assignment based on documentation in the chart to support clinical care provided, including preventives, Medicare Annual Wellness Visits, lowest and highest CPT E/M level, New Patient visits versus Consultation, and medical necessity. Assists in the provision of an efficient and effective clinical coding service within Carle by providing accurate and timely auditing and coding education to providers and coding team members to include CPT E/M coding, CPT Procedural Coding, and ICD10CM coding, as applicable. Ambulatory CDI work closely with HIM leadership and Compliance to assure Carle providers and coding team members are following all regulatory requirements for code assignment. Ambulatory CDI helps identify training needs through ongoing internal provider and staff audits and assists with remediation and reaudit post education. • Adhere to accepted coding practices, guidelines, and conventions and any pertinent hospital or medical staff policies and guidelines.

• Provide education and education materials related to coding for the coding team members and providers.

• Follow query and notification process and escalates, as necessary.

• Excellent organization

description:
Thai AI Product Tester
🎯 The Project
Productive Playhouse is building a talent pool of Thai speakers for an upcoming project testing and evaluating leading AI chatbots. The objective is to enhance response quality through direct user interaction with the various AI models.
Open to freelancers based outside the U.S.
This is more than one job. Apply once, and we'll keep you in mind for this project - and future ones that need your language skills.
The Details
We’re looking for independent contractor engagement (task-based - project-based).

• You choose which tasks to take, set your own hours, and are free to work with other clients any time. You can stay flexible as the project evolves.

• This is an iterative project, work arrives in batches (there may be pauses between them).

What You’ll Do
As an AI Evaluator, you'll play a critical role in shaping and improving the next generation of Generative AI. You'll participate in structured, hands-on evaluations by interacting directly with various AI models to assess their capabilities, safety, and helpfulness. Your insights and data will directly inform model development and optimization.
Exact tasks vary by project and will be spelled out in that project's Statement of Work (SOW) before you start. Depending on the role, your work may include:

• Testing and evaluating AI chatbots or language models through structured conversations, using assigned goals and prompts.

• Voice-based interactions with AI models - for projects that involve this, sessions are recorded, and audio may be shared with the client as part of the evaluation deliverable.

• Submitting deliverables (write-ups, ratings, screenshots, or recordings) in the format each task specifies.

✅ What We're Looking For

• Native or expert-level fluency in Thai, as spoken in Thailand

• Strong English reading, writing, and communication skills - assessment maybe required

• 18 years of age or older

• Hands-on experience using AI models or large language models

• Comfortable with both written and voice-based conversation - and good at asking sharp follow-ups

• Your own smartphone, computer, reliable internet, and comfort with web-based tools

• Able to pass a language proficiency assessment and AI evaluation task

• Responsive communicator - quick replies move you through onboarding faster

• Able to start within 48 hours

Why PPH? 🌍
🌍 Your language skills are the whole point - and this project pays for them
⚡ Apply once, get contacted directly when a spot opens - no chasing
🏠 Work from anywhere, on your own schedule, alongside any other work you do
🤝 Clear task specs, no ongoing oversight, no micromanagement
💼 Real project experience with a global data and language services company
✨ Work that actually improves how AI understands your language
About Productive Playhouse

We started by teaching kids through award-winning programming. We grew into a global data and language services company trusted by clients worldwide. But the mission never changed: keep language alive.
Transcription, translation, localization, linguistic analysis, AI evaluation - it all comes back to preserving languages and the cultures they carry.
All engagements are contingent upon successful completion of identity verification. Productive Playhouse is an equal opportunity organization headquartered in California and committed to diversity and inclusion across our global workforce. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and abilities, regardless of location or engagement type. For accommodations or inquiries, please contact .

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
description:
This is a Toronto based hybrid 2x/week in office position.

About OpenTable:

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most - their team, their guests, and their bottom line - while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team that includes and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

The Role:

The Senior Business Systems Analyst will join the Enterprise Systems Team within the Technology Operations organization and help build and deliver projects to increase business efficiency and automate global teams’ business processes. This individual will partner with finance, business, analytics, product, and engineering and manage several financial applications, configuring and building system enhancements, troubleshooting issues, and providing operational support to finance partners.

This is a Toronto based hybrid 2x/week in office position.

This position has responsibilities providing system improvements and operational support for monthly financial close cycles, so flexible work hours will be required to coordinate with global tasks and teams.

In this role, you will:

• Monitor system performance across multiple financial applications, maintain system documentation, provide administrative support, and provide user support for bug fixes and future enhancements.

• Work closely with the finance and engineering teams to understand functional requirements, system implementation and execute end-to-end integration testing

• Ensure accuracy and alignment with partner requirements and oversee user acceptance testing.

• Strive to become the system domain expert, find new opportunities for process improvements, dig deep into requests, and determine partner needs to solve problems.

• Ensure that incidents get resolved in an efficient and timely manner.

• Learn and use tools such as NetSuite, Salesforce, SoftCo, Expensify, Celigo, Nolan as well as custom built applications and integrations.

• Ensure strict alignment on compliance and control requirements, especially handling sensitive financial data and supporting IT SOX audits.

 

Please apply if you have:

• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience, preferably with an engineering/technical background.

• 3+ years of finance systems experience.

• Technical skills with prior hands-on experience with financial systems such as ERP, AP Automation, AR Receivables, Travel and Expense, Enterprise O2C, R2R, P2P integration platforms.

• Previous experience with Netsuite is strongly preferred.

• Supported monthly financial close and have expertise in financial processes related to order to cash, procure to pay and record to report domains.

• Critical thinking and strong analytical skills, with great attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, adherence to data governance and control requirements.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to partner effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Eagerness to constantly learn and grow in the role while adapting to whatever new systems are needed in the future.

 

Benefits and Perks

• Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

• Focus on mental health and well-being:

• Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

• Company-paid subscription to Headspace

• Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

• Paid parental leave

• Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday

• Paid volunteer time

• Focus on your career growth:

• Development Dollars

About Scale Media
For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.
Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.

The Role
We're looking for a Senior Director, Growth to lead our paid acquisition and Amazon teams across our portfolio of DTC wellness brands.
This is a senior role, but not a pure strategy role. We need someone with deep platform expertise who is in the data every day, managing performance with the team and raising the bar on media buying. We expect Meta and paid social to be our biggest growth levers, so strong Meta experience is essential, and you'll lead performance across every paid channel.
On top of daily performance, you'll work with the VP of Growth and Analytics to set LTV/CAC and MER targets by product line, decide what signal we send to every channel, and help shape how paid media supports retention. DTC paid media drives significant halo to Amazon, so you'll lead Amazon alongside DTC and manage how the two work together.
You'll partner closely with Analytics, Creative, and Ecommerce, and report to the VP of Growth.
What You'll Own

•
Daily performance management. Reviewing performance every day across brands, channels, and Amazon, catching issues and opportunities early, and driving the team to act on them.

•
Leading the paid acquisition and Amazon teams. Managing and developing both teams, raising the bar on media buying, and building the next layer of leaders.

•
Cross-channel strategy and budget allocation. Deciding where the next dollar goes across brands, product lines, and channels (Google, Meta, Bing, others).

•
Unit economics and targets. Working with the VP of Growth and Analytics to set LTV/CAC and MER targets by product line, and holding acquisition to them.

•
Signal strategy. Deciding what signal we send to each platform, such as value-based bidding, LTV- or margin-weighted conversions, and offline events, and making sure it's implemented correctly.

•
Amazon. Leading the Amazon channel and measuring and managing the halo between DTC paid media and Amazon sales.

•
Paid media and retention. Shaping how paid media supports retention, including existing-customer suppression, win-back, and new vs. returning customer reporting by channel.

•
Measurement. Working with Analytics and our measurement partners (MTA, lift testing, MMM) to continuously improve how we decide where to allocate budget.

•
Testing. Running a structured test roadmap across channels, tactics, offers, and landing pages, and knowing which results to scale and which to cut.

•
AI-enabled workflows. Driving the use of AI tools and automation across acquisition to speed up reporting, analysis, and optimization.

What Success Looks Like

• Double-digit new customer revenue growth while hitting brand and product-level LTV/CAC and MER targets

• Scaled paid media spend across channels and brands

title: Member of Technical Staff, ML Platform
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an ML infrastructure engineer to own model evaluation at Runway, end to end. Every decision we make about a model - which checkpoint to keep training, what to ship to millions of users, which datamix and architecture shows the most promise - rests on evals. Today that work is spread across the organization. You'll turn it into one platform.

Your job will be to design and build the systems that generate samples at scale, score them with automated metrics and human annotations, track results across checkpoints and releases, and put the answers in front of researchers in minutes rather than days. You'll define what "better" means operationally - how we measure it, how confident we are, and how a result becomes a ship/no-ship decision.

You'll be embedded within research teams as a member of ML Platform, and you'll set the technical direction for evals across the company. This is an extremely high-leverage role: the quality of our models is bounded by how well we can measure them.

A PEEK AT OUR TECHNICAL STACK

Our inference and training code is written in Python (PyTorch) and is cloud-native. We leverage multiple clouds and use a combination of Kubernetes native and home-grown tooling for efficient job orchestration.

We’re big users of agentic development and operations. We have a robust internal platform and provide broad access to the latest models and harnesses.

You’ll have access to best-in-class models, agents, GPUs, storage and cloud services you need to drive a world class evaluation pipeline that helps us deliver frontier models.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the evaluation platform end to end: the tooling and systems required to generate, annotate, review and adapt at frontier scale

- Define the CLIs, APIs, GUIs and storage layers required to make this process seamless, fast, sophisticated and collaborative

- Work directly with research teams on video, image, audio, agents, and robotics to understand what they need to measure and build it, then generalize the result into the platform

- Help set the standards for how we evaluate models at Runway: reproducibility, metric definitions, reporting formats, and when a result is trustworthy enough to act on

- Support broad adoption of the platform and its integration throughout Runway’s research efforts across training, production model serving and more

- Contribute broadly as a member of the ML Platform team to tools and systems that help Runway train and serve frontier models

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 5+ years of experience building ML infrastructure or data platforms in production environments, with at least some of that time spent on evaluation, experimentation, or benchmarking systems

- Strong Python and PyTorch, and hands-on experience running large batch GPU workloads on Kubernetes

- Experience designing data pipelines and storage for large volumes of media or model outputs, with attention to versioning and reproducibility

- Familiarity with experimental statistics: paired comp

title: Représentant(e) commercial(e) - Genève
description:
Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun.

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.

L'OPPORTUNITÉ

Rejoins notre équipe en tant que représentant(e) commercial(e) et deviens l'un des visages de la révolution digitale du secteur. Chez Salonkee, tu as l'opportunité unique de piloter des projets ambitieux, de collaborer avec des experts passionnés et de marquer de ton empreinte l'expansion d'une scale-up en plein essor.

TES MISSIONS

- Ambassadeur(rice) de terrain : tu mènes des présentations produits directement sur site pour démontrer, avec clarté et conviction, la valeur ajoutée de nos solutions pour le business de tes clients.

- Conseil stratégique & optimisation : tu accompagnes tes prospects avec expertise en leur proposant des solutions digitales sur mesure pour optimiser leurs processus et libérer tout leur potentiel de croissance.

- Stratégie multicanale : tu utilises différents canaux de communication pour approcher les clients potentiels et développer des relations de confiance durables.

- Accompagnement & formation : tu assures la formation de tes nouveaux clients pour garantir une adoption parfaite de l'outil et un succès immédiat dès le premier jour d'utilisation.

title: Category Specialist (WM)
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, we’re building technology that makes life in local neighborhoods simpler. Wolt Market is our online grocery business, bringing customers a curated range of everyday essentials quickly and reliably.

The Category Team shapes the assortment, promotions and supplier collaboration behind that experience. As a Category Specialist, you will be the operational backbone of the team ensuring promotional plans, data, communication and follow-ups move accurately and on time.

What you’ll be doing

This is a hands-on coordination role at the centre of the Category Team. You will work closely with Category Managers, suppliers and internal stakeholders to keep commercial activities organised, accurately documented and delivered on schedule.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

• Coordinate the collection, follow-up and communication of promotional plans with suppliers.

• Maintain accurate trackers, files and timelines for promotions, campaigns and category initiatives.

• Support Category Managers with administrative and executional tasks, including supplier and SKU-related processes.

• Act as a key point of contact between suppliers, Category Managers and internal teams, ensuring clear and timely activation of Promo Plan.

• Support post-campaign reporting and the preparation of materials used to evaluate promotions and commercial activities.

• Use systems, reporting tools and AI-enabled tools to improve accuracy, visibility and day-to-day efficiency.

Our humble expectations

We are looking for a highly organised and proactive team player who enjoys working in a fast-moving e-commerce environment.

• Experience in a coordination, commercial support, e-commerce or retail or FMCG role.

• Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

• Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills in Greek and English.

• Confidence working with Excel or Google Sheets, PowerPoint and everyday office tools.

• Comfort using systems and reporting tools, with curiosity and willingness to adopt AI and automation tools.

• A collaborative and hands-on approach, with the motivation to learn and grow in a commercial environment.

What’s in it for you

You’ll gain broad exposure to the commercial engine of a fast-growing online grocery business and work closely with Category Managers, suppliers and cross-functional teams. This role offers a strong foundation to build commercial, analytical and operational skills while helping shape more efficient ways of working through data, systems and AI.

Next steps

We review applications on a rolling basis. The recruitment process will include an initial conversation with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team and a practical assessment or working session relevant to the role. The Talent Acquisition team will guide you through the process and share the details at each stage.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table

title: Senior Facilities Operations Technician - Memphis
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Sr. Facilities Operations Technician at SpaceXSI, you'll dive in, operating and maintaining the critical facility systems that power our supercomputing data centers. Working hands-on with MEP systems, you’ll tackle maintenance, operations, and repairs, ensuring peak performance and reliability. Expect to troubleshoot complex issues, streamline processes, and collaborate with teams to keep our infrastructure running smoothly, directly supporting xAI’s mission to accelerate human scientific discovery through AI. 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Independently operate and maintain critical mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems in supercomputing data centers, ensuring high reliability and performance through hands-on maintenance, troubleshooting, and process optimization.

• Perform advanced maintenance and troubleshooting of critical data center systems like HVAC, power, and environmental controls, while mentoring junior technicians to ensure operational reliability.

• Oversee the maintenance and optimization of critical data center infrastructure, including power, cooling, and environmental systems, while leading a team of technicians to ensure operational reliability and efficiency.

• Responsible for MEP Infrastructure site safety and environmental compliance, ensuring the sites align with all local and regional health and safety requirements.

• Provide operational expertise for Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems at the datacenter facility. The systems and equipment can include pumps, piping, chillers, cooling towers, CRAH units, wiring, lighting systems, generators, motors, water supply, UPS and switchgear, etc.

• Routinely inspect all areas to ensure performance measures are being maintained and proactively self-report the problems of facilities.

• Experience with writing and executing MOPs, SOPs, EOPs.

• Perform daily inspections of critical systems.

• Identify and maintain spare parts inventory to minimize downtime.

• Coordinate and supervise scheduled system shutdowns.

• Develop and implement energy monitoring metrics.

• Support commissioning efforts by witnessing equipment startup, assisting with functional testing, and monitoring construction progress.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Electrical or 6+ years of hands-on operations/facilities work experience in lieu of degree (data center experience preferred).

• Knowledge of mechanical or electrical engineering principles and systems (both would be a huge plus).

• Experience and knowledge of all critical systems documentation including Plans, Procedures, and Operations Manuals.

• Experience and knowledge of Building and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems and Operations.

• Strong troubleshooting skills.

• Experience with PLC-based control systems and/or with Building Management Systems (Client).

• Excellent written and verbal communication and technical writing skills in English.

• Physical Requirements:

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.

• Ability to utilize hand tools and power tools as needed.

• Work is often performed in tight quarters, and physical dexterity is necessary to perform job fun

title: Compensation Operations Analyst
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s People team supports a complex, rapidly growing organization of researchers, engineers, and business teams. The Compensation function ensures accuracy, scalability, and operational excellence across all compensation tools, systems, and data flows.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Compensation Operations Analyst to build and run the systems, tools, and processes that power compensation at OpenAI. This role is deeply operational and technical: you will configure HRIS modules, manage compensation tools end-to-end, maintain pristine data quality, and ensure compensation cycles run flawlessly. You’ll partner closely with People Systems, Total Rewards, Finance, and vendors to keep our compensation infrastructure accurate, scalable, and audit-ready.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

- Build and maintain compensation datasets, dashboards, audits, and data flows across systems.

- Lead compensation vendor relationships, including implementation, troubleshooting, and data submissions.

- Diagnose and resolve system issues, identify root causes, and drive process and tooling improvements.

- Partner with People Systems and Engineering to enhance architecture, workflows, and automation.

- Ensure high data accuracy across compensation systems and proactively identify gaps, risks, or anomalies.

- Translate technical or complex compensation system issues into clear guidance for stakeholders.

- Have 5+ years of experience in compensation operations, HRIS systems, or total rewards tooling in high-growth or technology environments.

- Have advanced Excel skills and familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau or Looker; SQL or Python experience is a plus.

title: Senior Quality Engineer - Checkout & Payments (m/w/d)
description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.
Als Senior Quality Engineer - Checkout & Payments trägst du dazu bei, zuverlässige Zahlungsabläufe über Shopware, Shopware Payments und externe Systeme hinweg sicherzustellen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf praxisnahen Integrationstests, Testautomatisierung und Release-Validierung: Du prüfst, ob Kund:innen einen Kauf erfolgreich abschließen können, Bestell- und Zahlungsstatus korrekt sind und Fehler sowie Wiederholungsversuche sicher verarbeitet werden.
Du wirst Teil des Bereichs Quality Operations innerhalb von Delivery Excellence und arbeitest eng mit den Teams Checkout & Payments, dem Produktmanagement und weiteren Quality Engineers zusammen. Du bringst Qualität früh in die Feature-Planung ein, überführst Produktrisiken in ausführbare Tests, untersuchst Fehler und gibst klare Empfehlungen zur Release-Bereitschaft. Die Position ist eine Senior-Engineering-Rolle ohne Führungsverantwortung. Du entwickelst das bestehende Framework für Abnahmetests und die CI-Infrastruktur weiter, statt eine separate Testorganisation aufzubauen.
Requirements

• Risikobasierte Testabdeckung definieren und umsetzen. Arbeite mit Product und Engineering zusammen, um kritische Abläufe für Händler:innen und Kund:innen, die vorhandene Testabdeckung und Lücken zu identifizieren. Stimme für jedes Entwicklungspaket einen klar abgegrenzten Testumfang ab und begleite ihn durch Umsetzung, Review und Validierung.

• Automatisierte Tests entwickeln und pflegen. Nutze TypeScript, Playwright sowie API- und Integrationstests, um das Verhalten im Storefront, in Shopware, im Payments-Service und an den Schnittstellen zu Zahlungsanbietern zu prüfen. Wähle die passende Testebene, statt jede Prüfung in einem Browser-Test abzubilden.

• Zahlungsergebnisse prüfen, nicht nur das UI-Verhalten. Kontrolliere Bestellerstellung, Zahlungsstatus, Beträge und Währungen. Ergänze die Testabdeckung entsprechend dem Produktrisiko um relevante Szenarien zu Stornierung, Einzug, Rückerstattung, Webhooks und Wiederherstellung.

• Integrationsfehler gemeinsam mit Entwickler:innen bewerten. Prüfe bei Bedarf Authentifizierung, Mandantentrennung, wiederholte Anfragen, Idempotenz und asynchrone Statusänderungen. Stelle sicher, dass Fehler weder doppelte Zahlungen noch inkonsistente Bestellungen verursachen.

• Testergebnisse für die Auslieferung nutzbar machen. Integriere und pflege Produkttests gemeinsam mit Engineering und Product Operations in der CI. Verbessere Testdaten, Wiederholbarkeit und Diagnosemöglichkeiten. Unterscheide zwischen Produktfehlern, Problemen bei Zahlungsanbietern oder Umgebungen und instabilen Tests.

• Releases und Kompatibilität validieren. Prüfe relevante Release-Artefakte, Upgrades und unterstützte Konfigurationen im bestehenden Release-Prozess. Überführe Erkenntnisse aus Vorfällen in Regressionstests und konkrete Verbesserungen.

• Eine klare QA-Empfehlung kommunizieren. Erläutere gegenüber Product und Engineering den geprüften Umfang, die Ergebnisse, verbleibende Risiken, Blocker und nächsten Schritte. Sprich Prioritätskonflikte frühzeitig an und begleite offene Punkte bis zu ihrer Lösung, einer vereinbarten Übergabe oder einer klaren Entscheidung.

• Verantwortung und Wissen teilen. Prüfe Testcode, arbeite mit Kolleg:innen im Pairing und verbessere gemeinsam nutzbare Fixtures und Dokumentation. Stimme dich mit anderen Quality Engineers ab, damit die Testabdeckung von mehreren Personen gepflegt und unterstützt werden kann.

Das bringst du mit:

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Pflege automatisierter Tests für produktive Software, einschließlich API- und Integrationstests sowie End-to-End-Tests.

• Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in TypeScript oder JavaS

title: 2026 SkillBridge Intern *Open to Active Duty US Military Only* (US Remote)
description:
Job Description
At Blue Cross NC , we recognize the dedication, discipline, and leadership that transitioning service members bring to the workforce. Through our DoW SkillBridge Program, we provide a unique opportunity for military personnel in their final months of service to gain hands-on experience in a civilian work environment while exploring meaningful career paths in the healthcare industry.

By joining Blue Cross NC ’s SkillBridge Program, service members can deploy their leadership, problem-solving skills, and mission-driven mindset in a civilian setting. This internship provides a bridge between military service and a meaningful career in healthcare, allowing participants to continue their tradition of service-this time, by helping make healthcare better for all.

We are honored to support transitioning military professionals as they navigate this next chapter and invite you to explore how your skills can make a difference at Blue Cross NC . **This program is open to only active military service members.**

• Develop and execute strategic military and veteran-focused initiatives that advance Blue Cross NC 's brand, business objectives, member outreach, retention efforts, and community impact. Strategies will include improving access to healthcare, behavioral health resources, benefits education, and social determinants of health for active-duty service members, veterans, and military families.

• Collaborate with County Engagement teams and cross-functional business units to implement community-informed strategies that primarily support Healthy Blue, Blue Cross NC ’s Medicaid plan.

• Build and maintain relationships with military installations, Veteran Service Organizations (VSOs), Military Service Organizations (MSOs), Veteran Service Officers, healthcare providers, community-based organizations, and government agencies to expand Blue Cross NC 's reach and impact.

• Identify and implement opportunities for education and outreach initiatives focused on healthcare access, behavioral health, chronic disease prevention, food insecurity, housing stability, and other priority issues affecting military and veteran populations.

• Lead and support military community events, Veteran Stand Downs, benefits education seminars, health screenings, wellness initiatives, and evidence-based training programs that connect individuals to healthcare resources and Blue Cross NC products and services.

• Collaborate with Public Health, Faith-Based, Tribal and Regional Liaisons, and other business-facing divisions to ensure coordinated engagement strategies that maximize community impact and support organizational goals.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png]

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

 

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі.
Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

 

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Зараз ми в пошуку System Administrator.

Виклики, які чекають на цій ролі:
- підтримка IT інфраструктури;
- керування постачальниками послуг;
- контроль доступу до систем та сервісів;
- допомога не технічним командам у вирішенні технічних задач.

Що для нас важливо:
- Розуміння принципів керування доступами: SSO, MFA, групи та ролі, принцип мінімальних прав
- Практичний досвід з Google Workspace або схожим сервісом (користувачі, групи, пошта)
- Базові знання DNS, мереж і VPN
- Впевнена робота з Windows/macOS
- Уміння швидко розбиратися в нових SaaS-сервісах та читати англомовну документацію
- Акуратність, уважність до деталей, відповідальність за доступи й облікові дані
- Комунікабельність: чітке спілкування зі співробітниками, уточнення запитів, пояснення рішень простою мовою
- Виражене бажання рости й вчитися в адмініструванні, безпеці та автоматизації

Буде перевагою:
- Досвід з Okta або іншим IdP (Azure AD, JumpCloud)
- Досвід з менеджерами паролів (1Password, Bitwarden)
- Cloudflare: DNS, керування доменами; розуміння SPF/DKIM/DMARC
- GCP (IAM, service accounts)
- IaC (Terraform, Pulumi) та Git
- MDM для Apple (Jamf, Kandji, Intune)
- Скриптинг (Python, Bash) або автоматизація через n8n, Zapier
- Досвід у техпідтримці чи helpdesk, робота з тікет-системами (YouTrack, Jira)
- Slack на рівні адміністратора
- Інтерес до безпеки та compliance (PCI DSS, ISO 27001), AI-інструментів (ChatGPT, Claude)

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

- Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег - кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.

- Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір - від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо.

- Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці - і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.skelar.tech/ і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави.

- Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат - з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом зростання команд, отримуємо вау-досвід та працюємо ефективніше.

- Турбота про щоденний комфорт. Сніданки, обіди, доступ до спортивних тренувань в Києві або часткова компенсація занять у Варшаві, медичне страхування, оплачувані відрядження, якщо специфіка ролі передбачає такі поїздки, корпоративні знижки від партнерів.

title: Workplace Manager
description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a proactive, organised, and people-focused Workplace Manager to lead the day-to-day operations of our London HQ and help create an exceptional employee experience.

This is a hands-on role that combines workplace operations, employee experience, office management, and continuous improvement. You’ll ensure the office runs smoothly, efficiently, and compliantly while helping to shape a workplace culture where people feel supported, connected, and able to do their best work.

Working closely with the Workplace Operations Coordinator and cross-functional teams including People, IT, Finance, and Executive Assistants, you’ll oversee workplace systems, vendor management, office projects, events, health & safety, and operational processes. You’ll also play a key role in improving how we work by introducing smarter systems, automation, and AI-driven efficiencies across workplace operations.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing operational excellence with hospitality and employee experience in a fast-paced, scaling environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

WORKPLACE OPERATIONS & OFFICE MANAGEMENT

- Lead the day-to-day running of the London office, ensuring the workplace operates efficiently, professionally, and proactively at all times

- Partner with the Workplace Operations Coordinator to oversee front-of-house operations, meeting rooms, catering, hospitality, office standards, and employee support

- Manage and resolve operational issues quickly and effectively, ensuring strong ownership of ticketing workflows, response times, contractor responses.

- Develop and continuously improve workplace systems, processes, documentation, and operational playbooks

- Manage relationships with vendors, contractors and service providers, alongside oversight of budgets, invoices, and operational spend

- Support with planning and execution of company events, including meetings, off-sites, socials, volunteering initiatives, and cultural programmes, ensuring a high-quality employee and stakeholder experience

- Provide reception cover during absences, acting as a professional and welcoming first point of contact

- Support upcoming office move activities including planning, communications, coordination, design, and execution

- Manage key workplace platforms including desk booking, ticketing, access control, learning systems, digital signage.

- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and employee experience through smarter systems, AI tools, and workflow automation

- Use data, reporting, and employee feedback to drive continuous improvement across workplace operations

HEALTH, SAFETY & COMPLIANCE

- Own day-to-day workplace health & safety processes and compliance requirements for the London office

- Conduct workplace audits, DSE assessments, risk assessments, and maintain accurate compliance documentation

title: AI Architect and Software Architect (100% Remoto)
description:
We are knowmad mood !
Somos una compañía líder en transformación digital, en constante evolución y a la vanguardia de la tecnología. Nacimos para provocar un cambio real a través de la innovación y el desarrollo sostenible, con la misión de aportar valor a los clientes e impulsar nuestro talento.
Formado por más de 3.000 personas creativas, digitales e innovadoras conectadas a un propósito y capaces de generar conexiones con personas de todo el mundo. Un equipo responsable, flexible y con alta capacidad de adaptación a las necesidades de nuestros clientes y del mercado, a la vez que proporciona valor, visión, creatividad, expertise, profesionalidad y pasión por la tecnología en cada proyecto.
Los valores que marcan nuestro rumbo y nos guían hacia la excelencia son la colaboración, la innovación, el compromiso, la diversión y la conﬁanza.
Únete a nuestro equipo como 💻 Software Architect & AI 💻 y disfruta de un entorno de trabajo innovador y colaborativo.
Ampliamos equipo de trabajo en el área de Inteligencia Artificial Generativa con una persona que tenga amplia experiencia en arquitectura y desarrollo de software así como experiencia en IA Generativa aplicada al desarrollo de software.
Algunos de los servicios que prestamos:
• Modernización de aplicaciones copilotada con IA Generativa. Un diagnóstico y un plan personalizado para la modernización de aplicaciones, dentro de un ecosistema funcional y tecnológico, asistido por IA, que nos permite acelerar el proceso y diagnosticar desde la fuente: el código que necesita ser modernizado.
• Formación en IA Generativa a equipos de desarrollo tanto internos como de clientes.
• Assessment a clientes donde analizamos código real, para generar planes de migración realistas y con menos riesgos.
¿Cuál será tu misión en el proyecto?

• Participación como responsable técnico en servicios de alto valor, acompañado de perfiles multidisciplinares, con interlocución directa con el cliente (definición de planes estratégicos, implantación de arquitecturas, AS-IS TO-BE, transformaciones digitales, etc).

• Asesoramiento y acompañamiento a los clientes en áreas de IA Gen (definición de procesos de implantación, alineamiento con el marco regulatorio y legal, POCs, AI powered, MLOps, LLMs, formación, etc). Muchas veces los clientes no saben aprovechar al máximo las herramientas de IA en su día a día por lo que nuestra misión es acompañarles en este camino e irles enseñando y acompañando.

• Soporte a Negocio: definición de Proyectos y Servicios, diseño e implantación de soluciones End2End, desarrollo de enfoques / soluciones y valoración de: Partnerships, Eventos, Oportunidades y Enfoques / Soluciones

• Formación tanto a cliente interno como externo sobre IA Generativa.

Requisitos mínimos

• Experiencia como arquitecto de software/soluciones con experiencia en estimaciones, gestión de riesgos e implantación de soluciones empresariales de diferentes tecnologías.

• Experiencia trabajando con IA Generativa en el desarrollo de software.

• Experiencia y capacidad para apoyar acciones comerciales, hacer presentaciones, defender soluciones.

• Experiencia impartiendo formaciones (muy valorable).

• Inglés B2 (muy valorable).

¿Qué ofrecemos?

• Contrato indefinido

• Modelo de trabajo en remoto 🏡. Opción de ir a trabajar a oficinas pero siempre a elección del trabajador.

• Horario flexible ⏰: horario flexible entrada 8.30h salida 18h con viernes intensivo de 8h a 15h y en verano (julio y agosto) intensivo de 8h a 15h

• Vacaciones 🌴: 22 días de vacaciones + 2 días de libre disposición, además de los días 24 y 31 de diciembre libres.

• Contrato indefinido 📄: Desde el primer día, con opción de 12 o 14 pagas.

• Retribución flexible 💳: Tarjeta restaurante, cheque guardería, seguro médico, formación y otros beneficios con ventajas fiscales.

• Club de ventajas 🎁: Descuentos en tecnología, ocio y formación.

• Formación continua 📚: Acceso a Udemy Business, cursos de idiomas, certificaciones oficiale
