title: (Senior) Manager, Business Development, SME & Growth
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

The SME & Growth team at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

What you'll do

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Account Executive (Business Development) team in Vietnam, translating company strategy into consistent sales execution, revenue growth, and strong customer outcomes. You will own team performance across revenue, pipeline health, forecast quality, and sales discipline, while helping build a scalable sales motion for SME and growth customers.

This is an onsite role based in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City.

Responsibilities:

- Own team revenue and commercial targets by setting clear goals, priorities, and execution plans.

- Establish a consistent operating rhythm through pipeline reviews, deal reviews, team meetings, one-to-ones, and performance reviews.

- Coach Account Executives across prospecting, qualification, discovery, solution positioning, objection handling, negotiation, and closing.

- Improve pipeline coverage, opportunity quality, stage progression, close plans, forecast accuracy, conversion, and sales velocity.

- Maintain strong CRM discipline, ensuring pipeline data, next steps, close dates, and forecasts reflect the underlying business reality.

- Join strategic customer and deal discussions, helping Account Executives navigate complex, consultative sales cycles.

- Partner with Marketing, Partnerships, Customer Success, Operations, Product, and Revenue teams to improve lead quality, customer handovers, sales processes, and customer outcomes.

- Share customer, market, and competitive insights to inform sales plays, enablement, product priorities, and go-to-market strategy.

- Support hiring, onboarding, ramping, training, performance management, and career development for Account Executives.

- Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, experimentation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

- Work from our Vietnam office five weekdays a week

Minimum qualifications:

- At least 7 years of relevant experience in banking, payments, PSP, fintech, e-commerce or platform-based businesses.

- Demonstrated experience in B2B sales, ideally in a consultative, solution-led, or complex sales environmen

title: Senior Product Manager, Audience Measurement & Media Data
description:
The Senior Product Manager, Audience Measurement & Media Data will lead a critical area of measurement innovation across streaming, broadcast, and cable television. This role will shape the products, platforms, and data capabilities that help media companies understand who is watching, what they are watching, and how audiences move across screens and platforms.
The role brings together audience measurement, advanced analytics, third-party signals, data science, engineering, and product strategy. You will lead the development of scalable measurement capabilities that combine viewing behavior with high-quality external signals to produce richer, more accurate, and more actionable insights.
Your work will directly support the needs of publishers, broadcasters, streaming platforms, advertisers, agencies, media buyers, and other industry stakeholders. You will help them make better decisions about content, programming, advertising, audience development, and media investment.
This is a highly visible leadership role for an independent thinker who can set direction in a complex and evolving market. You will own a meaningful part of the audience measurement ecosystem, make decisions across product and technology trade-offs, and partner with a broad set of technical, analytical, commercial, and operational teams to deliver measurable customer value.
Responsibilities

• Own the product strategy, vision, and roadmap for audience measurement and media data solutions across streaming, broadcast, and cable.

• Lead the full product lifecycle, from identifying customer needs and defining requirements through delivery, adoption, and improvement.

• Partner with engineering, data science, research, and analytics teams to develop scalable measurement solutions.

• Drive innovation by combining viewing data and third-party signals to improve audience insights and measurement accuracy.

• Define product priorities, performance metrics, and success measures while balancing business needs and technical requirements.

• Ensure data quality, reliability, privacy, and measurement integrity through continuous improvement.

• Collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve problems, and improve products.

• Lead cross-functional initiatives, manage priorities, and communicate product progress and results to leadership.

• Manage, mentor, and develop product team members, supporting performance, accountability, and career growth.

• Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience.

• 7+ years of relevant experience in product management, data products, analytics, technology, or related fields.

• Previous experience directly managing and developing employees.

• Experience owning data-driven products and managing the full product lifecycle.

• Ability to work with engineering, data science, and other technical teams.

• Strong communication, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in television, streaming, advertising, or audience measurement.

• Knowledge of cross-platform measurement, third-party data, and audience enrichment.

• Familiarity with data quality, APIs, cloud platforms, and modern data architectures.

• Understanding of statistical modeling or machine learning.
